profile.name: Chintamani Pala
profile.description: I am a Systems Engineer @TCS with a strong interest in building scalable web applications and AI-powered solutions. I completed my B.Tech from GIET University and have hands-on experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, React.js, Next.js, Express.js, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, and modern web development practices. I enjoy solving complex problems and have solved 350+ coding challenges on LeetCode. My recent projects include AI-powered applications, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, Chrome extensions, and full-stack web platforms. I am passionate about learning new technologies, improving system design skills, and creating products that deliver real value to users.

projects.name: WhatsApp Clinic Management Ai Assistant
projects.description: An AI-powered WhatsApp clinic management system that lets patients book and manage appointments through natural-language conversations. It combines agentic AI, automated reminders, digital prescriptions, and Razorpay payments with a clinic admin dashboard for managing doctors, schedules, patients, and revenue.

projects.name: Website Builder Agent
projects.description: An agentic AI system that transforms natural-language prompts into production-ready web pages. Built with Google ADK and Gemini, the system uses a sequential multi-agent workflow to analyze requirements, design responsive interfaces, and generate HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. It automates the front-end development process and exports deployable single-page websites with modern UI features such as animations and dark/light themes.

projects.name: YouTube Chat Plugin
projects.description: Chrome Extension enabling users to chat with YouTube videos using contextual AI responses. Implemented a RAG pipeline using FastAPI, LangChain, Supabase, and Gemini. Developed a responsive popup UI with multilingual support for major Indian languages.

projects.name: AI-Powered Code Editor
projects.description: An AI-powered online code editor designed to enhance developer productivity with intelligent code assistance, error detection, auto-completion, multi-language code execution, and real-time runtime input. The platform also includes authentication, project and file management, code sharing, customizable themes, and a responsive interface for coding across devices.

projects.name: YT Transcript API
projects.description: A lightweight JavaScript API and CLI for retrieving YouTube video transcripts and subtitles without requiring browser automation. The library supports manually created and auto-generated transcripts, multilingual translation, proxy configuration, and multiple output formats including JSON, plain text, SRT, WebVTT, and formatted text. Designed as a reusable NPM package for easy integration into Node.js applications and command-line workflows.

projects.name: YouTube Video Information Scraper API
projects.description: A lightweight REST API that retrieves YouTube video information based on search keywords using web scraping techniques. Built with Python and Flask, the API processes search queries and returns structured JSON data including video titles, descriptions, views, likes, and other metadata, providing a simple interface for integrating YouTube search data into applications.
